newsitem.title: USA: Shaman files with SEC for 2 mln common.
newsitem.headline: Shaman files with SEC for 2 mln common.

text.p: Shaman Pharmaceuticals Inc filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to two million common shares.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 17,920,684 common, the filing said.
Net proceeds will be used for research and development, including preclinical and clinical testing and related regulatory activities, and for general corporate purposes.
Earlier today in a company announcement, Shaman said ity was going to file for up to 2.5 million shares.
Shamam Pharmaceuticals, based in South San Francisco, Calif., extracts drugs from tropical plants with a history of native medicinial use.
